ticks.note: Rejected: "The SCG is NOT asc-schedulable!" (lab server: also "Circular dependency involving x prevents scheduling this tick."). `x = x + 1` is a relative write with operator `=`, `x += 3` one with `+=`; different operators outside the {+=, -=, ++, --} family never commute, so the two writes conflict. Writing both as `+=` (or both old-style) is accepted.
